headline: Weakest Polar Vortex on Record Threatens Europe Gas Reserves
summary: The European Center for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts indicates a disruption of the Arctic polar vortex, risking cold air in Northwest Europe as the continent faces a thin energy supply buffer.
why: Europe's gas reserves and supply buffers are crucial for regional energy security and winter pricing stability, directly impacting regional utility companies and energy commodities.

impacts.name: European Utilities
impacts.why: Cold weather driven by polar vortex disruptions can increase energy demand and pressure gas reserves in Europe.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: An early polar vortex disruption threatens to deplete Europe's thin gas reserves rapidly during winter, raising concerns over energy shortages and heating supply costs.
